children: Contango Silver & Gold reported completion of major 2026 field programs, including a 50,000m+ Kitsault campaign and transition to a ~10,000m Lucky Shot underground drill program.
Manh Choh: Third 2026 campaign began Aug 20; Fort Knox mill modifications to recover higher-grade sulfide ore implemented; production on track with prior guidance.
Lucky Shot: Surface program finished Aug 29 (29 holes, ~5,800m); first assays released Sept 2; ~10,000m underground drilling to Feb 2027 to support 2027 Feasibility Study.
Johnson Tract: Road, barge access and portal pad works complete; geotechnical and environmental baseline studies largely finished, reducing development risk.
Kitsault Valley: Completed 123 holes totalling >46,446m across target areas; MRE update on track for late September, initial assays imminent for Torbrit and North Star.
Company to host conference call/webcast Sept 9 to discuss these project updates with CEO Rick Van Nieuwenhuyse.
